name: Onfido
tagline: Identity document verification and biometric KYC for fintech onboarding
description: Onfido provides identity verification APIs for document checks, biometric facial similarity, and KYC workflows used in regulated onboarding. Developers create applicants, upload or capture identity documents, run verification checks, and retrieve results via REST endpoints authenticated with API tokens.

auth.details: API token via Authorization: Token token=YOUR_API_TOKEN header; region-specific sandbox and live tokens from the Onfido dashboard

pricing.free_tier_limits: Uncharged sandbox testing with predetermined results; no personal data may be uploaded. Sandbox limit: 120 requests/minute, up to 2/second with a burst of 4. Live verifications require valid billing information.
pricing.paid_plans: usage-based identity verification pricing; contact sales for volume quotes

rate_limits: Live: 400 requests/minute unless contractually agreed otherwise, up to 7/second with a burst of 14. Sandbox: 120 requests/minute, up to 2/second with a burst of 4.
use_cases: create a KYC applicant and start identity verification
upload an identity document for authenticity checks
run facial similarity biometric match against a document photo
retrieve verification check results for an onboarding decision
list applicants or checks for compliance audit workflows
